purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Official MC Hafizabad publishes a 2023-24 city base-map PDF whose legend explicitly includes parcel boundaries. Hafizabad district GIS/revenue pages and Punjab PULSE/PLRA viewer material establish local and provincial cadastral context. The current viewer configuration points to a Punjab cadastral ArcGIS service with Hafizabad sublayer 10, but anonymous service metadata and a bounded feature query returned HTTP 200 with ArcGIS code 499 Token Required. No token was requested or used, and no safe polygon response was retained.
registryAssessment: Local registry/map evidence is present through MC Hafizabad's official parcel-boundary base map; the official district administration describes Revenue Administration maintenance of land records and registration oversight. This is registry/map evidence, not proof of legal title scope or complete citywide vector coverage.
